name: SkullKnightmon
main_effect:
[On Play] If you don't have [Nene Amano] in play, you may play 1 [Nene Amano] from your hand without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card has the [Blue Flare] trait or [Twilight] trait, add it to your hand. Trash the rest.
source_effect: ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
